q1_issues.issue: "The nightmoth crowd ... shrank" is an intransitive internal change-of-state, so its subject should be Patient (the class that covers spread / collapse / melt / weaken), not Theme.
"left silken threads on the lanterns" neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the threads, so the object should be Theme, not Patient.
The per-member distribution rule for that same clause repeats the Patient/Theme role error inside its conclusion.

notes: "The keepers of the East Row" is attached with the opaque Possession, but keeper is an agent nominalization whose of-phrase paraphrases as "who keeps the East Row", so the surface-preposition oblique (Of ...) of Complements of nouns and adjectives is arguably the licensed form. The final "The nightmoths" resolves to sk_crowd_1 rather than the earlier sk_moth_1 group -- defensible, but it leaves sk_moth_1 with a single fact.
